ex.en: The first item he bought was an alarm clock.
ex.zh: 他買的第一樣東西是鬧鐘。

ex.en: I called customer service because they sent me the wrong item.
ex.zh: 我打電話給客服，因為他們寄錯商品給我。

ex.en: The unclaimed items were sold off at auction.
ex.zh: 無人認領的物品被拍賣掉了。

item.en: a single thing in a group or a shop

ex.en: Let's proceed with the items on the agenda.
ex.zh: 我們繼續進行議程上的事項吧。

ex.en: Did you check all the items on the shopping list?
ex.zh: 你檢查過購物清單上的所有項目了嗎？

item.en: one thing on a list or plan

ex.en: I have an itch in my ear.
ex.zh: 我耳朵癢。

ex.en: The mosquito bite gave me a terrible itch.
ex.zh: 蚊子叮的地方癢得要命。

itch.en: an uncomfortable feeling on the skin that makes you want to scratch

ex.en: My whole body itches.
ex.zh: 我全身發癢。

ex.en: My nose itches.
ex.zh: 我的鼻子好癢。

ex.en: This wool sweater makes my skin itch.
ex.zh: 這件羊毛衣讓我的皮膚發癢。

itch.en: to have an uncomfortable feeling on the skin that makes you want to scratch

ex.en: Each iteration improved the software design.
ex.zh: 每次迭代都讓軟體設計更完善。

ex.en: The final iteration passed all the tests.
ex.zh: 最後一輪反覆修正通過了所有測試。

iteration.en: one repeat of a process, or a new version of something

ex.en: Everyone agrees to stay here for the night and make long-term itinerary decisions tomorrow.
ex.zh: 大家同意先在這裡住一晚，行程的事情明天再從長計議。

ex.en: I'll email you the itinerary for our trip to Tokyo.
ex.zh: 我會把東京之旅的行程用電子郵件寄給你。

itinerary.en: a plan of a journey that shows the places you will visit

ex.en: I lost my phone, but I found it under the sofa.
ex.zh: 我弄丟了手機，不過在沙發底下找到了它。

ex.en: She asked me about the test, and I told her it was easy.
ex.zh: 她問我考試的事，我說那很簡單。

it.zh: （虛主詞，指天氣、時間、距離等，通常不翻譯）

ex.en: It is raining hard, so take an umbrella.
ex.zh: 雨下得很大，所以帶把傘吧。

ex.en: It takes about twenty minutes to walk to the station.
ex.zh: 走到車站大約要二十分鐘。

ex.en: It is already ten o'clock at night.
ex.zh: 已經是晚上十點了。

ex.en: The cat licked its paw.
ex.zh: 那隻貓舔了舔牠的腳掌。

ex.en: The company is proud of its new product.
ex.zh: 這家公司為它的新產品感到驕傲。

ex.en: The city is famous for its night markets.
ex.zh: 這座城市以夜市聞名。

ex.en: The cat washed itself in the sun.
ex.zh: 那隻貓在陽光下替自己洗毛。

ex.en: The door closed by itself.
ex.zh: 門自己關上了。

ex.en: The idea itself is simple, but making it work is hard.
ex.zh: 這個想法本身很簡單，但要實現卻很難。

ex.en: Italy is shaped like a boot on the map of Europe.
ex.zh: 在歐洲地圖上，義大利的形狀像一隻靴子。

ex.en: Many people travel to Italy to enjoy the food and history.
ex.zh: 許多人到義大利旅遊，享受當地的美食與歷史。

ex.en: An Italian taught us how to make fresh pasta.
ex.zh: 一位義大利人教了我們怎麼做新鮮義大利麵。

ex.en: He speaks Italian with his grandparents on the phone.
ex.zh: 他和祖父母講電話時說義大利語。

ex.en: We had Italian pizza at a restaurant by the river.
ex.zh: 我們在河邊的餐廳吃了義大利披薩。

ex.en: She drives a small Italian car.
ex.zh: 她開一輛義大利的小車。
